## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.  
Fix duplicate command output for adopted settings so each adoption produces one progress message.

## Changes

Settings plans now return adoption records and an audit record with the number of incoming settings. The pull request adds tests for audit records in empty and nonempty plans and for their omission from command output.
